title: [Master]-Bug 646962: Withholding Tax Posting Setup
summary: Withholding Tax Posting Setup now validates that certain options are only available for employee-related withholding taxes, and blocks threshold period selection when inappropriate. This prevents misconfiguration when setting up withholding tax rules for vendors.
key_points: Restricts Calculation Base = Net to employee-only withholding taxes
Restricts Calculation Method = Compound to employee-only withholding taxes
Restricts non-Record/Line Withholding Threshold Base to employee-only taxes
Blocks Withholding Threshold Period selection unless Threshold Base is Category in Period or Total in Period
Displays error messages when invalid option combinations are attempted
quote: Block them showing error message that this option can be used only when withholding tax is for employees.
